verdict.rationale: Blink Shell is an iOS terminal and SSH/Mosh client, so natural-language-to-command generation is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or natural-language command generation: the docs describe typing commands manually, Smart Keys, Snips and SSH features. With no evidence for an applicable capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
